_doc: Split recipe for agents/harness-optimizer.md (dormant repo agent). Capability inventory: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash RETAINED via the verifier carrier (Bash read-only under carrier_bash_guard, enough for json.tool-style validation). Edit REPLACED by the patch-proposal-v1 output contract: the role proposes a unified diff and the parent applies it. Why (Owner option b, 2026-10-01): every surface this role edits is under .claude/, a protected path a headless run can never write (measured on GEX44 + permission docs; agent_carrier_run refuses such a grant with SURFACE_PROTECTED). Writer class was option a (2026-10-01 morning) and is superseded. The role page is kept verbatim, so its 'Apply changes' step is overridden by the contract, not edited. Prompt Defense Baseline moved to the shared primitive, byte-identical.

contract.name: Agent harness configuration optimizer
contract.sovereign_question: Which minimal, reversible harness change most raises agent completion quality?
consumers: parent session harness maintenance (applies the patch after review)

agent.description: Analyzes the local agent harness configuration and proposes a minimal patch for reliability, cost and throughput.
